articles.title: India's fighter jet engine efforts get a big boost: Desi Kaveri engine clears key step in Russia, ready for integration with stealth UCAV ‘Ghatak’
articles.summary: India's indigenous Kaveri dry engine successfully completed high-altitude and flight trials in Russia, exceeding its target thrust with 48.5 kN. Developed by DRDO, this milestone signifies crucial progress in India's aero-engine technology. It enhances self-reliance for future combat aircraft like the LCA Tejas, strengthening national defence capabilities and reducing reliance on foreign imports.

articles.title: India’s Javelin Deal: The Unending Loop of Procurement
articles.summary: India is set to acquire the battle-tested Javelin anti-tank system from the U.S., as announced by U.S. Ambassador Sergio Gor. The Indian Army has signed the letter of offer and acceptance, signaling a significant upgrade to its anti-tank capabilities. This procurement strengthens India's defence modernization efforts and bolsters strategic ties with the United States.

articles.title: The United States' decline is also China's problem

articles.title: Nel ASA: Secures additional orders for submarine PEM electrolyser stacks
articles.summary: Nel Hydrogen US, a subsidiary of Norway's Nel ASA, has secured additional purchase orders from Collins Aerospace for its advanced PEM electrolyser stacks. These crucial components are vital for producing hydrogen, likely destined for cutting-edge aerospace and defense applications. This collaboration highlights the growing integration of hydrogen technology into sophisticated systems, underscoring advancements in energy solutions for various sectors.
